q_001.sql: SELECT g.Name, SUM(il.UnitPrice * il.Quantity) AS TotalSales FROM Genre g JOIN Track t ON g.GenreId = t.GenreId JOIN InvoiceLine il ON t.TrackId = il.TrackId GROUP BY g.Name ORDER BY TotalSales DESC LIMIT 5;
q_001.answer: Name: Rock, TotalSales: 826.65; Name: Latin, TotalSales: 382.14; Name: Metal, TotalSales: 261.36; Name: Alternative & Punk, TotalSales: 241.56; Name: TV Shows, TotalSales: 93.53

q_004.sql: SELECT mt.Name, COUNT(t.TrackId) AS TrackCount FROM MediaType mt JOIN Track t ON mt.MediaTypeId = t.MediaTypeId GROUP BY mt.MediaTypeId ORDER BY TrackCount DESC LIMIT 1;

q_005.sql: SELECT e.EmployeeId, e.FirstName, e.LastName, COUNT(c.CustomerId) AS CustomerCount FROM Employee e JOIN Customer c ON e.EmployeeId = c.SupportRepId GROUP BY e.EmployeeId ORDER BY CustomerCount DESC LIMIT 1;
q_005.answer: EmployeeId: 3, FirstName: Jane, LastName: Peacock, CustomerCount: 21

q_010.sql: SELECT a.Name, COUNT(DISTINCT t.GenreId) AS GenreCount FROM Artist a JOIN Album al ON a.ArtistId = al.ArtistId JOIN Track t ON al.AlbumId = t.AlbumId GROUP BY a.ArtistId, a.Name HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT t.GenreId) > 3;
